_about: Which texture set each building part gets. A set is a folder here with diff.jpg (colour, sRGB), nor.jpg (OpenGL normal map) and arm.jpg (R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metalness). 'match' is a regular expression on the part name from factory_precision.obj. tileM = real-world size of one texture repeat in metres. To use a Megascans surface: export it as these three files into a new folder and change 'set'.
